title: A Comparative Evaluation of GPT-4 Turbo and Gemini-Pro in Medical Licensing Exams: Enhancing Artificial Intelligence's Role in Medical Education

live_model.evidence: GPT-4 Turbo achieved an accuracy rate of 90.99% on the January 2024 NBME Step 1 questions (Results); prompts submitted via the OpenAI API

prompt.location: Methods, 'Prompt engineering and logical structuring' (template described: stem, query, options, request for justification; Figure 1)

claim.location: Results text and Figure 2 (90.99% = 101/111; text reports 112 items collected, 7 excluded)

data.source: NBME Step 1 self-assessment questions (January 2024 set), copyrighted and not distributed

notes: Comparator was Gemini-Pro 1.0 and the question set is dated January 2024, so the run almost certainly used gpt-4-0125/1106-preview despite the 2026 publication date. Error categories were adjudicated by humans; accuracy is key-based.
